title: Closed Areas Regulation, Schedule 3, section 17 (North Thormanby Island)

source.version: BC Laws consolidation current to October 13, 2026

source_text:
Schedule 3 No Shooting or Hunting Areas (Section 4)
North Thormanby Island
17 That portion of M.U. 2-16 which is contained within the following described boundary: The mean low water mark of North Thormanby Island. [am. B.C. Reg. 459/90, s. 1.]
